name: brdcomp-collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: A simple show/hide disclosure pattern that toggles content visibility with a trigger control.

examples.title: Collapsible content
examples.code:
import { Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent } from "@/components/ui/collapsible"

<Collapsible>
  <CollapsibleTrigger>Show details</CollapsibleTrigger>
  <CollapsibleContent>Hidden content.</CollapsibleContent>
</Collapsible>
